title: CON retransmit affinity: tiebreaker favoring retransmissions in TX queue
description: Problem: TX queue treats CoAP CON retransmissions the same as fresh sends — both compete on priority and deadline. But a retransmission represents airtime already invested by the sender. Dropping it wastes more cumulative airtime than dropping a fresh packet. Fix: Add a boolean is_retransmit flag to TxItem. Within the same priority level, retransmissions sort before fresh sends (tiebreaker only — never promotes across priority levels). Not a separate queue, not a priority bump — just FIFO-within-priority becomes retransmit-first-within-priority. Spec impact: document in appendix-bufferbloat.md as TX queue scheduling refinement.
design: TxItem gains is_retransmit: bool (default false). Ordering: (priority, !is_retransmit, insertion_order). Preemption policy unchanged — retransmit flag does not protect against preemption by higher priority. Python: TxEntry sort key adds retransmit field. Rust: TxItem Ord impl adds the flag. C: tx_queue comparison function checks retransmit bit.
